_comment: node render.mjs jobs.json — render the qa_copy.py copy of the page, not the repo file. Every path must be absolute. The first job defines window.__sp(id, p), which scrubs the scrolly [data-scrolly=id] to progress p; later jobs reuse it because state carries over within the tab.

jobs._: full page with every reveal/draw/grow forced to its final state (an IntersectionObserver page is blank below the fold otherwise)
the hero, reloaded so the forced-reveal style is gone; vp:true captures the viewport as-is
a scrolly stage at progress 0.02 — defines __sp first; stages are position:sticky so vp:true is REQUIRED
a non-sticky figure card: scroll it into view (so its reveals fire), wait for the transitions, clip the element
the same card after clicking a segmented-toggle button
a hover state: dispatch mouseenter on the labelled element
a widget in a second state: set the sliders and fire input events
jobs.prep: var r=document.getElementById('f4-ra'); r.value=60; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); var s=document.getElementById('f4-rb'); s.value=90; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); 1
